To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the algorithms of resynchronization before watermark extraction are robust to RST attacks, but they are sensitive to other kinds of attacks.
RST invariant watermarking algorithms have been developed and can be classified into two types: one is the resynchronization method, the other is the RST invariant domain method.

1) The RST invariant image embedding domain is a very important concept for image watermarking; 2) The RST transformed image resynchronization method can be used for RST robust image watermarking; and 3) The RST semi-invariant image embedding domain is very useful for RST invariant image watermarks.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following issues: (i) to give an overview of RST invariant watermarking algorithms; (ii) to analyze the performance of the typical R ST invariant image watermarking schemes and point out their strengths and weaknesses; (iii) to discuss the future research direction for RST invariant watermark- ing.
the development of a novel RST invariant image digital watermarking algorithm based on the wavelet transform.
the development of a new watermarking technique for digital images.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the watermarking algorithms based on RST invariant domain are more robust than those based on RST resynchronization.
the algorithms of the second category are better than the first category in terms of robustness to RST attacks.
the RST invariant image embedding algorithms have not been fully studied and there are still a lot of problems to be solved.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the RST invariant watermarking algorithms based on RST transform domain are more robust against geometric attacks than those based on image resynchronization.
the RST invariant image embedding algorithms based on resynchronization have better performance than the algorithms based on RST invariant or seminvariant domains.
the watermarking algorithms based on RST invariant or RST semi-invariant domains are more suitable to be used for RST invariant watermarking.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the RST invariant image watermarks can be embedded in the DCT, DFT, and DWT domain.
there are many ways to embed a watermark in an R ST invariant or semi-invar iant domain, which can be used to improve the robustness of image watermarking algorithms.

, for the resynchronization based methods, the watermark extraction accuracy is highly sensitive to the synchronization errors, and the performance of these methods is highly dependent on the synchronization accuracy; for the invariant/semi-invariant domain embedding based methods, the robustness of watermark is not high enough, and the watermark extraction accuracy may be influenced by the image noise.
